United Airlines Says It Resolved Tech Problem That Delayed Departures

Companywide outage affected tools that the airline uses to communicate with pilots

By

United Airlines UAL 1.20 % increase; up pointing triangle said it resolved a technology issue that had delayed some flights Monday afternoon.

The outage affected tools the airline uses to communicate with pilots and other employees, according to the union that represents its pilots. The airline wasn’t able to provide outbound flights with final weights needed before departure.
